name: Cultural Valuation Structure
l1_summary: Cultural Valuation Structure is supported by 79 findings from 4 papers in the corpus. Primary evidence: associational studies (58/79). Key finding: Cultural Features vs. Tourism Infrastructure → Total Fixation Duration (TFD) (increase, d=150).
